question.text: Which of the following entities falls under Category-II of FPI classification under SEBI (FPI) Regulations, 2019?

explanation.text: The Logic: Endowments and foundations are listed under Category-II FPIs, along with regulated funds not eligible as Category-I, charitable organisations, corporate bodies, family offices, individuals and unregulated funds. The Trap: Central banks, pension funds, university funds and sovereign wealth funds all sit under Category-I, not Category-II - this is a common confusion point when reading the category table. Note: Treat Category-II as the residual bucket: if the entity is government, regulated or FATF-linked it falls in Category-I; if it is an endowment, foundation, charity, family office, individual or similar, it usually falls in Category-II.
